author: Nintendo of America
description:
The Mario Tennis Fever game is available now, only on the Nintendo Switch 2 system. https://ninten.do/6002tNB20

It’s time to grab your gear and hit the court in Mario Tennis Fever! With 30 different Fever Rackets and 38 playable characters—the most in series history—you can mix and match to find your winning combination.

Serve up casual or competitive play in a variety of game modes. Help Mario and friends relearn their tennis skills and defeat the monsters to return to normal in Adventure mode, rally your pals for multiplayer action locally* or online**, and more!

*Additional games, systems, and/or accessories may be required for multiplayer mode. Games, systems, and some accessories sold separately.

**Nintendo Switch Online membership (sold separately) and Nintendo Account required for online features. Membership auto-renews after initial term at the then-current price unless canceled. Not available in all countries. Internet access required for online features. Terms apply. nin
title: Mario Tennis Fever – Launch Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
